'''Perampalam Kanagasabapathy''' (1923–1977) was a [[Ceylon Tamil]] mathematician, academic and dean of the Faculty of Science at the Jaffna Campus of the [[University of Sri Lanka]].

==Early life and family==
Kanagasabapathy was born in 1923.<ref name=Arumugam>{{cite book|last=Arumugam|first=S.|title=Dictionary of Biography of the Tamils of Ceylon|url=http://www.noolaham.org/wiki/index.php?title=Dictionary_of_Biography_of_the_Tamils_of_Ceylon|year=1997|page=72}}</ref> He was the son of Iyampillai Perampalam from [[Erlalai]] in northern [[British Ceylon|Ceylon]].<ref name=Arumugam/> He was educated at [[Jaffna Hindu College]].<ref name=Arumugam/> After school he joined the [[University of Ceylon]].<ref name=Arumugam/> He then went to the [[University of Cambridge]], graduating with a master's degree in mathematics.<ref name=Arumugam/>

Kanagasabapathy married Meenambikai in 1949.<ref name=Arumugam/> They had three children (Pathmini, Mythili and Nanada Kumaran).<ref name=Arumugam/>

==Career==
Kanagasabapathy worked at the [[University of Ceylon]], Peradeniya from 1950 to 1974 as a lecturer, senior lecturer and professor of mathematics.<ref name=Arumugam/> He joined the Jaffna Campus of the [[University of Sri Lanka]] in October 1974 as a professor of mathematics.<ref name=Arumugam/> He was head of the Department of Mathematics and Statistics and dean of the Faculty of Science at the Jaffna campus from October 1974 to January 1977.<ref>{{cite web|title=Brief History of the Faculty|url=http://www.jfn.ac.lk/sci/aboutUs.html|publisher=Faculty of Science, [[University of Jaffna]]|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130114220331/http://www.jfn.ac.lk/sci/aboutUs.html|archivedate=2013-01-14}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Dean's Office|url=http://www.jfn.ac.lk/sci/deansOffice.html|publisher=Faculty of Science, [[University of Jaffna]]|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140111204441/http://www.jfn.ac.lk/sci/deansOffice.html|archivedate=2014-01-11}}</ref> He died in January 1977.<ref name=Arumugam/>
He published number of papers in Mathematical Journals.<ref>{{cite journal|title=THE SIMULTANEOUS DIOPHANTINE EQUATIONS y2−3x2=−2 and z2−8x2=−7|first1=Tharmambikai|last1=Ponnudurai|first2=P.|last2=Kanagasabapathy|date=1 January 1975|journal=The Quarterly Journal of Mathematics|volume=26|issue=1|pages=275–278|doi=10.1093/qmath/26.1.275}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/mathematical-gazette/article/div-classtitle2816-a-new-proof-of-the-compositeness-of-fspan-classsub5spandiv/6C273B9F1AEE8C7FB62430D5E3187F69|title=2816. A new proof of the compositeness of F5|first=P.|last=Kanagasabapathy|journal=The Mathematical Gazette|volume=42|issue=342|pages=309–310|via=Cambridge Core|doi=10.2307/3610473|jstor=3610473|year=1958|s2cid=189167892 |url-access=subscription}}</ref>
